mapper.select: SELECT g., COALESCE(f.file_count, 0) as file_count FROM file_system_group g LEFT JOIN ( SELECT file_system_group_id, COUNT(*) as file_count FROM file_system WHERE file_system_group_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY file_system_group_id ) f ON g.file_system_group_id = f.file_system_group_id ORDER BY g.file_system_group_sort ASC, g.file_system_group_id ASC
